high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "thepulseindia." The post is titled "TALIBAN'S STATEMENTS CONTRADICTED BY THEIR ACTIONS" and has received 854 likes. Text Content: The post discusses the contradiction between Taliban statements and their actions regarding women's rights. It mentions that very few Taliban officials permit girls to attend school past puberty, while others do not permit girls' schools at all. The post also states that the Taliban has already put a stop to co-education schools in Afghanistan.
